note: The old test's records, delivered as a bundle; the aliases are the cvids (scb:<cvid>) and the workbook rows. The workbook's Individ row 600 (AmPolTyp) is narrowed to 2020, the old test's year, and row 601 declares Thing_LISA in 2020. SCB: cvid 10 is AmPolTyp on VarId 31619 in variant 153 (the old named-a), cvid 11 the same spelling on VarId 999 in variant 1335 (named-b), cvid 13 Thing_MiDAS in variant 153 (distinct-suffix); 10 and 13 share the 2020 variant-153 edition, so Thing_LISA's 2020 edition is present but has no counterpart. Every expected value is the old test's assertion.
